items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Brian Rice, great musician, and his band. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I was in his-

ctx.x: The accordion. The accordion. We used to go all over and play like that, you know. And it sure sounds good. Yeah. Perfect song. Perfect song. Perfect song. Perfect song. Yeah. And we, we used to knock that number out.

And don't forget to tell him about, uh, your friend, uh, who was at his house yesterday, Emmis White. Oh yeah. Oh yeah, he's talking about everybody. And he spoke about Jeff, Greta Jeff, Brian Rice, great musician, and his band.
